parameters.description:
`msg-to-pushover` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Pushover destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Pushover destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Pushover destinations bound per enrollment.

Log into pushover.net — your User Key is displayed right on the dashboard. Scroll down and register an Application (give it a name); Pushover issues an API Token for that application. Install the Pushover app on your phone or desktop and sign into the same account so it receives the notifications you send.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Pushover destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushover token

user_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Pushover user key
